column9: 8. What practical changes would encourage you to waste less food?
Tasting unfamiliar food dishes so that it would be easy to take that particular dish or not.

1. Half-scoop options & tasting spoons: Let people sample unfamiliar dishes or take smaller portions first, going back for seconds only if needed.
2. Visible full menu at the entrance: Knowing all options upfront prevents overfilling plates before seeing favorite dishes later in line.
3. Slightly smaller plates: Naturally curbs over-serving without feeling restrictive.
4. Clear spice/ingredient labels: Avoids abandoned food caused by unexpected heat or flavors.
5. Counter nudges: Simple signs or daily waste tallies at the serving and return counters keep portion mindfulness top of mind.
